claims: The 98th Academy Awards will air live on ABC on Sunday, March 15, 2026, at 7 p.m. ET/4 p.m. PT.
The 98th Academy Awards will stream on Hulu including ad-supported tiers on Sunday, March 15, 2026, at 7 p.m. ET/4 p.m. PT.
Red carpet coverage for the 98th Academy Awards begins at 3:30 p.m. ET/12:30 p.m. PT on ABC, Hulu, and E!.
ABC is the TV channel for the 98th Academy Awards.
Accessing ABC for the 98th Academy Awards requires cable or antenna.
Hulu is the primary streaming home for the 98th Academy Awards.
ABC.com and the ABC app are available for cable subscribers.
YouTube TV, FuboTV, and Hulu + Live TV are live TV services for the 98th Academy Awards.
